events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a defining event of the 1960s counterculture, began on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, the mud, music, and magic of Woodstock began. Which iconic performance still resonates with you?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The world marks the anniversary of the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who died on this day in 1977.

angles.name: King of Rock and Roll
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since we lost the King. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: The hip-hop world remembers influential artist Tupac Shakur, who passed away on this day in 1996 following a shooting in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since we lost a true icon. Tupac's legacy continues to shape music and culture.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The music world pays tribute to legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago, we lost a guitar genius. Jimi Hendrix truly redefined what was possible on six strings.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history, isn't it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to Chrissie Hynde, the formidable frontwoman of The Pretenders, born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the iconic voice of Oasis and solo artist, Liam Gallagher, born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Our Kid's Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today.

events.title: First iPod Released Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the groundbreaking first-generation iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: We celebrate James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the very first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on this day in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate 007 theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the incredible life and enduring music of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary actor, comedian, and writer, John Cleese, born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in the UK on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Masterpiece
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that proved they could do anything.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world remembers the incomparable Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Unmatched Voice
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a true legend. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
